notes: Reviewed every named fund page exposed by Amber's current fund navigation; two vehicles met all four inclusion tests and eight were excluded for geography.
Reviewed 2026 KIDs, latest full-year or quarterly disclosures, post-year-end continuation evidence and fund-attributed North American holdings for the included vehicles.
Treated INPP ordinary shares and USF's USF/USFP currency trading lines as one commercial vehicle each; no feeder, parallel or sidecar was added.
Reviewed the Babcock and Brown/BBPP lineage, the 2009 management buyout, the 2023 USF appointment and the 2024 Boyd Watterson combination.
North American projects and managed-account references without a named investable vehicle plus fund-level lifecycle evidence were not elevated into separate rows.
For listed vehicles, reported NAV is recorded under the schema's AUM amount category; no FX conversion was imputed.

The official INPP 2025 annual-report PDF did not parse reliably, but the same-day regulated full-year-results announcement, 2026 KID and 2026 sustainability report were opened and covered the required facts.
